facts.fact: Rigathi Gachagua, leader of the Democracy for Citizens Party, told reporters at Wamunyoro in Kenya on 24 August 2026 that the electoral commission's results-transmission contract specifications were tailor-made for one company; the commission is a public body, and he also attacked the Ruto administration's taxation and security record.
